title: Grateful Dead Live at The Omni on 1991-04-04
source: Master Audience Recorded By Mr. Baker, Transfer By Keo; 2 Sennheiser 441s > Sony D6, Tapes:Maxell MX-S 100's; Transfer With Nakamichi MR-1 > Korg MR-1000 @ 1 Bit/5.6 MHz; Tracking/Sample Rate Conversion With AudioGate V.3.0.2 To 32/96 kHz Wave; Dithered/Flacked With Korg Aqua To 16/44; SBE's Checked/Fixed With Trader's Little Helper; Metadata Tagging With Tag&Rename

ai_review.summary: Tinny recording but captures an energetic performance with a standout Help > Slip > Franklin’s sequence.
ai_review.review: The show is described as okay to pretty good, with high energy that the audience could feel, especially during the Help‑Slip‑Franklin's medley. The audio is noted as tinny, lacking depth and clarity, but remains listenable enough for fans to enjoy the performance.

ai_rating.rationale: Only one review; it rates the show positively (4/5) but calls the recording tinny, leading to a moderate overall rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Tinny sound with thin high‑frequency response; lacks depth and crispness but is still usable.

standout_songs: Help on the Way > Slipknot! > Franklin's Tower
show_quality.setlist_flow: Energetic throughout, with audience enthusiasm highlighted during the Help‑Slip‑Franklin's segment.
